newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese police kill wanted Palestinian.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese police kill wanted Palestinian.

text.p: Lebanese police shot dead on Sunday a Palestinian accused of belonging to a gang charged with making up to 15 billion Lebanese pounds ($10 million) by selling forged and genuine finance ministry revenue stamps.
Farid Mousalli was killed in an exchange of fire with police trying to arrest him in the Keserwan mountains northeast of Beirut, police said.

He was one of six people charged by a magistrate last month with forging revenue stamps and also selling for private gain genuine stamps supplied by a finance ministry official for a total of 15 billion pounds.
Acting finance minister Fouad Siniora denied on Friday that the embezzlement totalled 15 billion pounds and said it totalled 3.8 billion.
